name: skill-ovos-mqtt-adapter
description: Skill for OVOS to be controlled via MQTT protocol
author: jumper047

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content: Go to [[https://account.mycroft.ai/skills]], find Installer skill, paste url https://github.com/jumper047/mycroft-mqtt-adapter into "Skill URL" field and press "Save". As alternate way you can connect to your Mycroft instance via ssh and enter `mycroft-skill install https://github.com/jumper047/mycroft-mqtt-adapter`
